taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Rosales Rosaceae Rosa chinensis
description: Ancestor of most modern cultivated roses; layered, fragrant blooms in shades from white to deep red, one of the most widely traded cut flowers worldwide.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Liliales Liliaceae Tulipa gesneriana
description: Cup-shaped single bloom on a smooth upright stem; a Dutch auction staple, sold by color and bulb-grown for a short spring season.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae Chrysanthemum morifolium
description: Dense, many-petaled flower heads on branching stems; long vase life makes it a high-volume auction flower.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Liliales Liliaceae Lilium longiflorum
description: Large trumpet-shaped white blooms with prominent stamens and a strong fragrance.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Asparagales Orchidaceae Phalaenopsis amabilis
description: Flat, broad-petaled blooms arranged along an arching spray; a premium potted and cut-stem orchid.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Caryophyllales Caryophyllaceae Dianthus caryophyllus
description: Ruffled, densely-petaled bloom on a jointed stem; prized for very long vase life and easy dyeing.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae Helianthus annuus
description: Large flower head with yellow ray florets around a dark central disc, on a thick upright stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae Leucanthemum vulgare
description: Classic white-petaled, yellow-centered daisy on a slender stem, often used as filler in mixed bouquets.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Asparagales Iridaceae Iris germanica
description: Distinctive three-part falls-and-standards bloom, usually purple or blue, on a tall straight stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae Gerbera jamesonii
description: Large single daisy-like bloom in saturated colors on a bare, leafless stem; a bouquet-filler favorite.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Saxifragales Paeoniaceae Paeonia lactiflora
description: Large, densely-layered bloom, often fragrant, with a short but highly sought-after seasonal auction window.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Cornales Hydrangeaceae Hydrangea macrophylla
description: A dense rounded cluster of small florets forming one large mophead bloom, sold as a single stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Asparagales Iridaceae Freesia refracta
description: Small trumpet-shaped, strongly fragrant flowers arranged along one side of a wiry arching stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Asparagales Iridaceae Gladiolus communis
description: Tall spike lined with many funnel-shaped blooms that open sequentially from bottom to top.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Asparagales Amaryllidaceae Narcissus pseudonarcissus
description: Yellow trumpet-shaped central corona surrounded by a ring of petals; an early-spring bulb flower.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Ranunculales Ranunculaceae Anemone coronaria
description: Bold, poppy-like bloom, often with a dark central eye, on a smooth slender stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Ranunculales Ranunculaceae Ranunculus asiaticus
description: Tightly layered, paper-thin petals forming a rose-like rounded bloom in bright saturated colors.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Liliales Alstroemeriaceae Alstroemeria aurea
description: Small speckled, lily-like blooms in clusters on branching stems; known for exceptionally long vase life.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Lamiales Plantaginaceae Antirrhinum majus
description: Tall spike of tubular two-lipped blooms that open sequentially up the stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae Dahlia pinnata
description: Geometrically layered petals in a wide range of forms and colors, on a sturdy upright stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Gentianales Gentianaceae Eustoma grandiflorum
description: Rose-like, ruffled bloom on a slender branching stem, popular as a rose alternative in bouquets.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae Tagetes erecta
description: Dense, ruffled pompom-like bloom in yellow to deep orange, on a sturdy branching stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae Zinnia elegans
description: Bright, sturdy multi-petaled bloom on a stiff stem, common in summer cutting-garden mixes.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Asparagales Asparagaceae Hyacinthus orientalis
description: Dense spike of small, intensely fragrant star-shaped florets, an early-spring bulb flower.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Asparagales Amaryllidaceae Hippeastrum hybridum
description: Very large trumpet-shaped blooms, usually several per thick hollow stem, a winter-season showpiece flower.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Proteales Proteaceae Protea cynaroides
description: Large, architectural bloom with broad stiff bracts around a dense central head; a premium exotic/tropical stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Alismatales Araceae Zantedeschia aethiopica
description: Smooth funnel-shaped white spathe wrapped around a central yellow spadix, on a bare curved stem.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Fabales Fabaceae Lathyrus odoratus
description: Ruffled, butterfly-shaped fragrant blooms in clusters on thin climbing stems.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Magnoliopsida Caryophyllales Plumbaginaceae Limonium sinuatum
description: Clusters of small papery, long-lasting florets on winged stems; a common dried/filler flower.

taxonomy_string: Plantae Tracheophyta Liliopsida Zingiberales Strelitziaceae Strelitzia reginae
description: Bird-head-shaped bloom with vivid orange and blue pointed bracts, on a stiff upright stem; a signature tropical stem.
